messages.subject: Semiparametric Bayes
parts:
I've written a couple of Nimble functions to perform nonparametric Bayes.  I've also written a function to perform a semiparametric analysis.   But it would sure be nice if I could somehow update the parametric part by calling a compiled Nimble MCMC model rather than producing my own code in the function.  Has anyone tried doing this, and if so, could you send me an example.  Thanks.  

Gil
